title: llms.txt names each door and help twins share the guide's og:url (SCAN-1031)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. llms.txt labelled each operator door with its hero headline, so an assistant could not answer which door a person is; each line now leads with the door's own name (Coaches and guides, Studios and instructors, and so on) from the niche design registry, then the headline. A help twin of a marketing guide set its canonical to the guide but og:url to itself; og:url now follows the canonical. Metadata and a text route only, no door body touched.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=fs.readFileSync('app/llms.txt/route.ts','utf8');const h=fs.readFileSync('app/(help)/help/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!l.includes('NICHE_DESIGN[slug]?.short'))bad.push('llms door lines lost the door name');if(!/url: canonical,/.test(h))bad.push('help og:url no longer follows canonical');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1031: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when llms.txt stops naming the doors or a help twin's og:url drifts from its canonical.
